name: playgroup
note: THE SEATS THE CAPTAIN'S LOG ACTUALLY NAMES. Every commander here is written down in a real game's entry, not inferred. All three are mono-red, which is not a choice this file made -- goblin-storm 002 records the table as 'three mono-red decks' and 'the red density took the game over'. Three of Sean's playgroup's decks are NOT here because the log never names their commanders: Tom's blue-black deck, Tom's enchantment deck, and Alex's fight-based green deck. Guessing them would put an invention in a table where it would go invisible.

seats.note: Oliver. goblin-storm 002: 'Oliver on Krenko doing token-and-ping ... Oliver killed the table on turn five off Krenko tokens and pings.' WHICH Krenko is not stated; Mob Boss is the assumption and is recorded as one.
Tom. goblin-storm 002 names him on Purphoros; edgar-vampires 004 has him pinging tokens with Goblin Sharpshooter.
Alex. Named exactly in ur-dragon 001: 'Alex on a mono-red Tannuk, Steadfast Second warp deck'.
